@router.post("/api/v1/webhooks/shopify/order-fulfill")
async def shopify_order_fulfilled(
    request: Request,
    hmac_header: str = Header(..., alias="X-Shopify-Hmac-Sha256"),
    shop_domain: str = Header(..., alias="X-Shopify-Shop-Domain"),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    raw_body = await request.body()
    calculated_hmac = base64.b64encode(hmac.new(
        settings.SHOPIFY_API_SECRET.encode(), raw_body, hashlib.sha256
    ).digest()).decode()
    if not hmac.compare_digest(calculated_hmac, hmac_header):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid Shopify signature")

    payload = json.loads(raw_body)
    internal_order_id = payload["note_attributes"].get("internal_order_id")
    order = db.query(InternalOrder).filter(InternalOrder.id == internal_order_id).first()
    if order:
        order.status = "FULFILLED"
        order.tracking_number = payload.get("fulfillments", [{}])[0].get("tracking_number")
        db.commit()
    return {"status": "updated"}
diagnosis: The endpoint correctly verifies Shopify's HMAC signature using the platform secret, but updates the internal order identified by internal_order_id in note_attributes without checking whether InternalOrder.merchant_store_domain == shop_domain. A store owner can send an order fulfillment webhook from their own legitimate shop while embedding another merchant's internal order ID, prematurely triggering fulfillment and tracking dispatch.

corrected_code:
@router.post("/api/v1/webhooks/shopify/order-fulfill")
async def shopify_order_fulfilled(
    request: Request,
    hmac_header: str = Header(..., alias="X-Shopify-Hmac-Sha256"),
    shop_domain: str = Header(..., alias="X-Shopify-Shop-Domain"),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    raw_body = await request.body()
    calculated_hmac = base64.b64encode(hmac.new(
        settings.SHOPIFY_API_SECRET.encode(), raw_body, hashlib.sha256
    ).digest()).decode()
    if not hmac.compare_digest(calculated_hmac, hmac_header):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid Shopify signature")

    payload = json.loads(raw_body)
    internal_order_id = payload["note_attributes"].get("internal_order_id")
    order = db.query(InternalOrder).filter(
        InternalOrder.id == internal_order_id,
        InternalOrder.merchant_store_domain == shop_domain
    ).first()
    if not order:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Order not found for shop domain")
    order.status = "FULFILLED"
    order.tracking_number = payload.get("fulfillments", [{}])[0].get("tracking_number")
    db.commit()
    return {"status": "updated"}
